_comment: Cargo target dirs, beyond build-<arch>, whose .fingerprint units a warnings reader must read for <arch>. Paths are relative to the worktree root; each pattern ends in '-*' and matches by prefix. Read by vibeos-lint's rust_ub_deny (include_str!) and tools/rust_warning_census.py (json.load), so the gate and the census cannot see different trees. Bodies a cell builds privately compile in body-storage; cell links in cell-link.
